name: Hanani
title: The Seer and the Prophet
summary: Hanani was a seer and prophet who served in the divided kingdom. He is best known for rebuking King Asa of Judah for forming an alliance with Ben-Hadad, king of Aram, instead of trusting in the Lord. He is also the father of the well-known prophet Jehu son of Hanani.

keyEvents.title: The Prophet's Message to King Asa
keyEvents.description: Hanani came to King Asa of Judah and rebuked him for relying on the king of Aram instead of on the Lord his God. He reminded Asa that the eyes of the Lord range throughout the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to Him.

keyEvents.title: Hanani Imprisoned
keyEvents.description: King Asa became so furious at Hanani's prophetic message that he had the seer thrown into prison. This shows the price the prophet paid for his faithfulness to God's word.

keyEvents.title: Hanani's Rebuke Regarding Asa's Alliance with Aram
keyEvents.description: Hanani pointed out that because Asa had trusted in the king of Aram instead of the Lord, the Aramean army had escaped. From now on, Asa would experience wars.

keyEvents.title: Jehu son of Hanani as prophet
keyEvents.description: Jehu son of Hanani followed in his father's footsteps as a prophet and spoke God's word to several kings, including Baasha of Israel and Jehoshaphat of Judah. In this way, Hanani established a prophetic family.

keyEvents.title: Reference in the book of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: A man named Hanani, brother of Nehemiah, brought news from Jerusalem about the condition of the wall. Although this is likely a different Hanani, the name shows the significance of tradition.
